description: High-Frequency Trading Hybrid Cloud with Physical Isolation.
query: We are a Zurich-based HFT (High-Frequency Trading) firm. We need to build a hybrid setup that connects our HQ to a private cage in a Zurich Tier IV datacenter. Requirements: 1) Absolute lowest possible latency connectivity (no shared internet). 2) Physically isolated compute infrastructure for our trading engine (no multi-tenant public cloud). 3) A dedicated security layer to lock down admin access to these trading servers. Please design the architecture using your 'Network', 'Cloud', and 'Security' families and provide the Upfront vs. Monthly TCO.

prompt_objects.query: We are a Zurich-based HFT (High-Frequency Trading) firm. We need to build a hybrid setup that connects our HQ to a private cage in a Zurich Tier IV datacenter. Requirements: 1) Absolute lowest possible latency connectivity (no shared internet). 2) Physically isolated compute infrastructure for our trading engine (no multi-tenant public cloud). 3) A dedicated security layer to lock down admin access to these trading servers. Please design the architecture using your 'Network', 'Cloud', and 'Security' families and provide the Upfront vs. Monthly TCO.

expected_solution: The agent must select 'Dark Fiber Connectivity' (NET-003) for the 'Microsecond Latency' requirement. For the compute, it must select 'Private Cloud Dedicated Compute' (CLOUD-014) or 'Swiss VPC' (CLOUD-006) to satisfy the 'Physical Isolation' requirement. For security, it must select 'Privileged Access Management (PAM)' (SEC-012) to lock down admin access ('Keys to the Kingdom'). The TCO calculation must include the high one-time fees for Fiber Splicing and PAM Design.
evaluation_criteria: Selects NET-003 (Dark Fiber) over standard internet/SD-WAN due to latency requirement
Selects CLOUD-014 (Dedicated Compute) or CLOUD-006 for physical isolation
Selects SEC-012 (PAM) for admin security
Calculates TCO correctly: e.g. NET-003 (8.5k One-Time + 1.2k/mo) + CLOUD-014 (2.2k/mo) + SEC-012 (47k One-Time)

query: We are a Swiss Private Bank running legacy SAP ECC. We need to migrate to S/4HANA while keeping all historical data (10+ years) for compliance. We are moving to the RISE model. We need a partner to handle the TECHNICAL migration, the ADVISORY for the RISE contract transition, and the implementation of strict 'Firefighter' controls for the new system. Please list the specific service products required and the total one-time project fees.

prompt_objects.query: We are a Swiss Private Bank running legacy SAP ECC. We need to migrate to S/4HANA while keeping all historical data (10+ years) for compliance. We are moving to the RISE model. We need a partner to handle the TECHNICAL migration, the ADVISORY for the RISE contract transition, and the implementation of strict 'Firefighter' controls for the new system. Please list the specific service products required and the total one-time project fees.

expected_solution: The agent must distinguish between the technical migration and the commercial transition. It must select 'SAP S/4HANA Brownfield Transformation' (SAP-001) for the 'Keep historical data' requirement. It must select 'SAP RISE Transition Service' (SAP-011) for the 'Advisory/Contract' requirement. It must select 'SAP GRC Access Control Swiss' (SAP-015) for the 'Firefighter' requirement. The One-Time cost sum should be: SAP-001 (12.5k + 85k) + SAP-011 (25k) + SAP-015 (35k).
evaluation_criteria: Selects SAP-001 (Brownfield) instead of Greenfield
Selects SAP-011 for the RISE transition advisory
Selects SAP-015 (GRC) for the Firefighter requirement
Accurately sums the one-time project fees (~157,500 CHF)

description: Healthcare IoT segmentation with legacy OS constraints.
query: We are a Zurich hospital. We have 500 legacy MRI machines and patient monitors running Windows XP that cannot be patched or have agents installed. We need to connect them to our central network for data collection but must strictly isolate them to prevent ransomware lateral movement. What specific network security architecture do you propose, and what are the detailed costs for protecting 500 such devices?

prompt_objects.query: We are a Zurich hospital. We have 500 legacy MRI machines and patient monitors running Windows XP that cannot be patched or have agents installed. We need to connect them to our central network for data collection but must strictly isolate them to prevent ransomware lateral movement. What specific network security architecture do you propose, and what are the detailed costs for protecting 500 such devices?

expected_solution: The agent must recognize that 'Endpoint Security' (WP-012) cannot be used (Windows XP/no agent). It must recommend 'Network Access Control (NAC)' (NET-004) for dynamic VLAN assignment and 'Industrial IoT (OT) Segmentation' (NET-010) or 'Zero Trust Architecture' (SEC-009) to create micro-segments. It should propose placing these devices behind strict firewalls (from NET-010 or NET-006). Pricing should be based on the number of devices (500) for NAC licenses and potentially hardware firewalls.
evaluation_criteria: Correctly rejects agent-based endpoint protection for Windows XP
Proposes network-level isolation (NAC + OT Segmentation/Firewalls)
Includes NET-004 and NET-010 in the solution
Calculates pricing for 500 devices based on NAC per-device/port fees

description: GDPR/nFADP compliant archiving for sensitive patient data.
query: We have 2PB of sensitive patient data (PACS images) that must be archived for 20 years to comply with Swiss law. This data must be immutable (WORM), stored strictly in Switzerland, and searchable within 4 hours if requested by a court. We need a solution that handles the storage and the compliance workflow. What is the 20-year TCO for this archive?

prompt_objects.query: We have 2PB of sensitive patient data (PACS images) that must be archived for 20 years to comply with Swiss law. This data must be immutable (WORM), stored strictly in Switzerland, and searchable within 4 hours if requested by a court. We need a solution that handles the storage and the compliance workflow. What is the 20-year TCO for this archive?

expected_solution: The solution must combine 'Swiss Object Storage (S3)' (CLOUD-002) for the 2PB WORM storage and 'Data Strategy & Governance' (CON-006) or a custom consulting project to define the retention policies. It might also leverage 'SAP Data Archiving' (SAP-009) if the source is SAP-related, but for generic PACS, CLOUD-002 is key. The agent needs to calculate 2PB * price/GB * 12 months * 20 years, potentially factoring in a discount for 'Cold' storage if available or standard rates if not.
evaluation_criteria: Selects CLOUD-002 for Swiss-only immutable storage
Confirms WORM/Object Locking capability for compliance
Calculates a massive TCO (2PB = 2,000,000 GB) correctly over 20 years
Suggests a governance/consulting wrapper (CON-006) to ensure legal compliance

description: End-to-end office move with zero downtime for trading floor.
query: We are moving our trading floor (50 users) to a new building in Zurich. We need 100% uptime for voice and data during the move. The new office needs fully redundant 10Gbps connectivity, Wi-Fi 6, and a new Teams Room setup for the boardroom. We also need to physically move the PC hardware on a weekend. Please build a full project plan including all necessary connectivity, workplace, and consulting services.

prompt_objects.query: We are moving our trading floor (50 users) to a new building in Zurich. We need 100% uptime for voice and data during the move. The new office needs fully redundant 10Gbps connectivity, Wi-Fi 6, and a new Teams Room setup for the boardroom. We also need to physically move the PC hardware on a weekend. Please build a full project plan including all necessary connectivity, workplace, and consulting services.

expected_solution: This requires a 'bundle' of Network and Workplace services. Key components: 'Dark Fiber Connectivity' (NET-003) or 'SD-WAN Swiss Connect' (NET-001) for redundant 10Gbps. 'Managed LAN & Wi-Fi' (NET-002) for the new office network. 'Meeting Room Modernization' (WP-010) for the boardroom. 'Workplace Strategy' (CON-015) for the move planning. The agent should construct a timeline that sequences connectivity installation *before* the move weekend.
evaluation_criteria: Includes NET-003 (Dark Fiber) or high-end NET-001 for 10Gbps requirement
Includes NET-002 and WP-010 for office fit-out
Includes CON-015 or custom consulting for the physical move coordination
Creates a logical project timeline where connectivity is live before the move date
